description: This file defines a class Cvss with methods to convert CVSS score to severity labels and a helper method for range checking.

classes.name: Cvss
classes.description: A utility class for converting CVSS scores into severity labels.

methods.name: toSeverity
methods.description: Converts a CVSS score to a severity string ('none', 'low', 'medium', 'high', 'critical').

methods.name: betweenValue
methods.description: Checks if a value falls within a specified range.
